description: Opt-in add-on: automerge Ignition-related dependencies after the standard quarantine. Not part of the default preset since not every project tracks Ignition. A repo that wants this extends both presets.

packageRules.description: Ignition-related deps track upstream after a shortened quarantine. Patch only for now, since 8.x moves mostly at the 8.3.x level; minor still needs review. Three days rather than the default seven: an Ignition patch is a narrow upstream bugfix from a single vendor, and holding it a full week mostly delays fixes we already want. Own groupName so a repo's `container images` / other grouping rules in the default preset can't dilute automerge onto unrelated packages sharing the branch. Explicit list rather than a substring match, since a wrong match here means an unreviewed merge; add to it as new Ignition-related deps show up. This will need a rework once Ignition moves to its year-based version scheme (2027.x.x).
